parsed.post: New personal best: 0.995805! Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 with DEPTH=6, WARMUP=0.05, WD=0.01, and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=524288 yielded significant gains. It seems the lower learning rate allows the high-capacity model to converge much more effectively within the 5-minute budget. Next: testing half batch 262144 to increase step count.
parsed.description: Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase the number of optimizer steps, building on the success of the low MATRIX_LR (0.03) experiment.
